protocol: docs/PROTOCOL.md confirmation lane (registered commit, deferred scoring, committed manifests, scored once); eval-v2.3; runner = nano/eval.py confirm / confirm-manifest / confirm-score
frozen_from: nano/harness.py = E002b, promoted 2026-10-16: 4 Luna samples, then a Sol judge picks among the public-green files (or a Luna repair when none is green)
gate: C2-LOOK1 PASS on the dev-holdout (X:inc = this file vs D, r = 2, registered at 8e07801e): all-pass lift >= +10 pp with CI95 low > 0
schedule: one replicate per UTC day (daily Luna cap), generation only; after both generate, both manifests are committed, each replicate is scored once, and the two ledgers are pooled

decision_rule.authority: only runs/c2-confirm2/pooled-summary.json (a2d lift pool over both replicate ledgers) decides; per-replicate summary.json files are descriptive
decision_rule.validity: INVALID unless the pooled summary is complete, integrity_ok (no hidden-name hit, zero tool calls on any lane), not aborted, with excluded (void) tuples <= 5% and the controller's guards met (>= 10 families, >= 1 discordant pair per comparison)
decision_rule.per_comparison: controller class on the pooled ledgers, whole-family percentile bootstrap with the controller's fixed seed: SUPPORTED if CI95 low > 0 and lift >= 0.10; RULED OUT if CI95 high < 0.10; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
decision_rule.overall: the controller's pooled claim (claim rule all-supported over X:frozen>D, X:frozen>B: SUPPORTED iff both comparisons are Supported; RULED OUT iff the first pair, X:frozen vs D, is RuledOut; Invalid and IntegrityReview dominate; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE), downgraded from SUPPORTED to INCONCLUSIVE if the worst-case void imputation (X voids as fails, comparator voids as passes) puts either point lift below 0.10. confirm-score computes both and writes runs/c2-confirm2/decision.json

claim_wording: At an equal invocation cap of 5 model calls per task, a two-model harness (at most 4 Luna calls plus 1 Sol judge call at medium effort) produces working software (every hidden test passes) more often than Luna alone in a plain repair loop (D, at most 5 Luna calls) and in best-of-5 with public-test selection (B). Not cost- or token-matched: Sol is a stronger model from the same vendor, X used about 4.6x D's tokens on dev, and no cost-matched control (e.g. D plus one Sol call) is run. Calls and tokens by lane are reported beside the claim
secondary: hidden-test fraction lift; calls and tokens by lane per arm; E002 branch counts (judge, one-green, no-green repair) from the harness's DIAG lines; family sign-flip p; per-replicate classes (descriptive)

power.method: docs/experiments/analysis/c2_joint_power2.py: the registered rule (both comparisons SUPPORTED; RULED OUT on X vs D), 36 x 4 tasks, r = 2, SE = 3.2, 400 sims
power.targets: PROTOCOL: P(SUPPORTED | +15 pp) >= 0.8 is met (0.92). P(RULED OUT | 0) >= 0.8 is NOT met (0.73)
power.exception: 2026-10-17, recorded before any confirmation call: the RULED OUT power target is not met at r = 2 (0.73 < 0.8). The owner's rule spends the set now (look 1 PASS, frozen harness, two reviews), and r is bounded by the daily cap and budget, so the shortfall is accepted and disclosed: a null harness would be reported INCONCLUSIVE rather than RULED OUT about 27% of the time. INCONCLUSIVE is the most likely outcome at the dev estimates (0.59)

design: one registered r = 2 run split by UTC day (daily Luna cap): replicate 1 is the registered run, replicate 2 its pre-registered replicate extension; no further extension. Generation --jobs 8 (look 1's value), scoring --jobs 6 (the parity check's value)

instrument.controller_commit: 32e72a53 (last change to crates/: C2-ISO2, merged after look 1's gate). The controller itself refuses to run or score if crates/, Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock differ from the registration commit; debug builds are not byte-reproducible, so each replicate's binary sha is logged in attempt-r<n>.json rather than enforced
instrument.parity: the A/A run's 420 submissions re-scored by the new and the old binary on this machine at the same load: 420/420 identical on compiled, passed, failed, expected, timed_out, all_passed, exit_success. Against the original ledger both binaries differ on one record (X:a cron-next-l3: a timeout under the original run's load, 31/32 now; all-pass false either way). All-pass 311/311. Scoring wall time +22% (about 30 ms per sandboxed process)
instrument.reference_check: a2d lift validate under the new oracle (counts only): dev 140/140, dev-holdout 100/100, confirmation-2 144/144 accepted (references pass every test, mutants caught)
instrument.judge_lane: built by the same model_provider as the coder lane (codex exec with shell, exec, web and app tools disabled); any tool call on any lane sets integrity_ok = false

failure_policy: Each replicate is attempted once: attempt-r<n>.json is written before any model call, and the runner refuses to rerun. A daily-cap deferral before launch is not an attempt. If a generation fails or aborts before generation_complete, no outcome is known (scoring is deferred): the partial run is kept and reported, and that replicate may be relaunched once with the same seed in a new output dir, recorded in the LOG; a second failure ends confirmation-2 as not run (no claim; the set is spent). Tuple-level operational failures are the controller's voids, bounded by the validity gate and the worst-case imputation. Scoring runs once; the controller refuses to rescore a ledger, so an interrupted scoring is reported as failed
disclosures: Confirmation-2 tasks were authored blind by Sol (gpt-6.1-sol, high) and the judge is Sol (medium): an authorship confound. On dev, C2-E2 bounds it: a Claude Opus judge picked a passing file on 66/68 decisive tuples vs Sol's 68/68
The judge shuffles candidates with a seed derived from the task id, so the order is the same in both replicates
144 tasks / 36 families after the disclosed spreadsheet-eval exclusion (2026-10-15)
The oracle changed between look 1 and this run (C2-ISO2); see instrument.parity and instrument.reference_check
Winner's curse: the dev estimate +8.9 pp vs D averages selected dev stages; E002b's fresh confirm stage alone was +7.1 pp vs v0 (= D). Look 1's numbers are withheld from me until the final report
Spending now uses the set: it cannot confirm a later, better harness in this regime, and an INCONCLUSIVE result does not authorize another confirmation attempt on it
